title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Customize the Role Center
summary: A blog series covering multiple aspects of customizing Role Centers in Business Central, including AL development techniques, cue display optimization, and agent customization for tailored user experiences.
key_points: Index of linked articles on customizing Role Centers in AL
Covers the error you get when adding an OnAction trigger to a Role Center page
Shows how to display real Cue counts instead of the 999+ cap
Explains opening another page instead of the Role Center at launch, and adding custom pages, reports and queries to Role Explorer
Includes a tip for hiding the Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent icons
